description: Add a video to a playlist of the channel: playlist_id, or playlist_title (found or created as private/unlisted).

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

playlist_privacy.description: default private. Public only via update_youtube_video with human approval.

playlist_title.description: Playlist title; found or created if no playlist_id is given

name: add_to_youtube_playlist
